display_name: ASPCA Pet Health Insurance offline clone

frozen_journeys.description: An anonymous synthetic quote selects billing frequency and one opaque approved sandbox scenario. The server prices the persisted pet selections, consumes the approval, inserts one policy, and enqueues one branded local-simulation confirmation mail in a single transaction. No credential field is collected.

A declined or retryable sandbox attempt creates a durable attempt but no enrollment or mail; a later approved scenario against the current quote fingerprint converges to exactly one policy and one local-simulation mail.

payment_contract.amount_source: Server-side integer minor units derived from the persisted ASPCA quote pet selections and billing frequency; monthly charges one quoted month and annually charges twelve quoted months. The client cannot supply or influence the amount.
payment_contract.owner: A site-bound quote owner key derived by the server from the quote id; every flow, attempt, enrollment and mail job remains bound to that quote snapshot.
payment_contract.fingerprint: SHA-256 over canonical JSON containing site id, quote id, billing frequency, normalized contact email, current ordered pet selections, server-derived amount and USD currency.
payment_contract.final_commit: consume_approval(), INSERT aspca_enrollments, and enqueue policy-confirmation LOCAL_SIMULATION mail execute on one SiteBackend SQLite connection and transaction; rollback leaves approval unconsumed and creates no policy or mail.

proof_obligations: Only opaque configured sandbox scenario ids are accepted; all payment credentials, client amounts, currency, owner, fingerprint, flow ids and provider tokens are rejected.
Amounts use integer USD minor units derived from persisted quote selections and billing frequency on the server.
Duplicate and concurrent approved submissions converge to one consumed attempt, one policy, and one policy-confirmation local mail job.
Declined and retryable attempts create no enrollment and no mail, while a later approved attempt can converge to the single valid enrollment.
A stale quote fingerprint or foreign owner cannot consume an approval or create a policy.
Approval consumption, enrollment insertion, and mail enqueue roll back together after any final-state failure.
Reset clears site-local payment, enrollment and mail rows; backup and restart preserve them with their site binding.
The only adapter is local-sandbox; Stripe test, live payment, SMTP and production mail requests remain unavailable.
Cross-site databases, accounts, payment flows, attempts, policies and mail jobs cannot be shared or replayed.
